close_reason: fixed: sort_thread_email_ids now parses RFC 3339 to UTC for comparison
description: common/mod.rs sort_thread_email_ids (~L127) sorts emailIds by receivedAt using lexicographic string comparison. RFC 8621 §3 requires oldest-first by absolute time. A receivedAt of '2025-01-01T10:00:00+05:30' (UTC 04:30) sorts after '2025-01-01T05:00:00Z' (UTC 05:00) lexicographically but represents an earlier absolute time, reversing the intended order. Trigger: backend stores emails with non-Z timezone offsets in receivedAt. The seed fixture only uses Z-suffix timestamps, masking this in current tests.
title: sort_thread_email_ids: lex sort wrong for non-UTC receivedAt
